back.W3: Save what you often type and tap it on the keyboard in any app
back.W5: Copy a saved image with one tap and paste it anywhere

back.F2: Cutling types the text without it too
back.F4: With Full Access the keyboard can copy an image and add what you copied
back.F6: Cutling has no account, never connects to the internet, and does not read what you type

back.N3: Much more room, and every key types

back.N14: Tap a cutling and it is typed where you write
